placements.title: The act of saving a memory itself confers reviewer status on its creator
placements.frame: Does the expression describe a standing rule tying the reviewer role to the act of memory-creation, and how does that rule get tested, changed, or contested over time?
placements.why: src-1 states a system rule enforced by the e2e suite — saving a memory automatically enrolls its creator as a reviewer. This is a general behavior of the system (true of every save, not a one-time event), so it passes the narrative grain test as a recurring thematic subject about role-assignment mechanics rather than a fact to be filed under some other leaf. No existing structure or strata was supplied to hold it, so it is minted standalone with no forced parent.
